entry.name: trunc~
entry.description: trunc~ converts signals with values such as 1.75 to 1.0. Negative values are modified so that -1.75 becomes -1.0. This object is very simple but computationally expensive.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: A signal whose values will be truncated. Theobject converts signals with fractional values to the nearest lower integer value (e.g., a value of 1.75 is truncated to 1.0, and -1.75 is truncated to -1.0). This object is simple but computationally expensive.
